title: Ravi Dixit v. U.P. Power Corporation Limited and 5 Others
court: High Court of Judicature at Allahabad
coram: Hon'ble Manoj Kumar Gupta, J. and Hon'ble Prashant Kumar, J.
disposition: Demand notice withdrawn; fresh hearing to follow Supply Code.
headnote: On the Electricity Department's statement that the demand notice dated 1 June 2021 had been withdrawn and a fresh hearing notice issued, the Court held that no further direction was required except that the respondents proceed strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
facts: The petitioner, Ravi Dixit, challenged a demand notice dated 1 June 2021 issued by respondent no. 3. The notice, raised through the U.P. Power Corporation Limited and its officers, sought recovery of electricity dues from him. At the hearing, counsel for the respondent Electricity Department informed the Allahabad High Court that the impugned demand notice had been withdrawn. Counsel further stated that the petitioner had been issued a notice giving him a fresh opportunity of hearing on the demand.

holding_units.topic: Withdrawn demand; fresh hearing under the Supply Code
holding_units.holding: Because the impugned demand notice dated 1.06.2021 had been withdrawn and the petitioner had been given a fresh opportunity of hearing, no further writ direction was required, save that the respondents must proceed strictly in accordance with the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.
holding_units.flag: No numbered clause is stated; the order refers only to the procedure prescribed under the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

principle_tags.application: Once the impugned demand notice stood withdrawn and a fresh hearing notice had issued, the Court gave no merits direction and required only that the respondents follow the procedure prescribed by the Electricity Supply Code, 2005.

not_decided.point: The petitioner's liability for the electricity dues covered by the demand notice dated 1.06.2021
not_decided.note: The notice was withdrawn and a fresh hearing was to be held. The Court did not determine the dues.
